text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 46

ANTI-TERRORISM ORDER, 2011 (S 45/2011)

NOTIFICATION OF COMMENCEMENT In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1) of the Anti-Terrorism Order, 2011, the Minister of Home Affairs, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, has appointed 18th. July, 2011 as the date on which that Order shall commence. Dated this 25th. day of Syaaban, 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the 27th. day of July, 2011.

PEHIN UDANA KHATIB DATO PADUKA SERI SETIA USTAZ

HAJI AWANG BADARUDDIN BIN PENGARAH DATO PADUKA

HAJI OTHMAN, Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam.
